verdict.rationale: Pika documents a first-party 'Camera Director' tool that lets you 'reshoot a clip from any angle.' That is a real camera-control capability, but the one-line description says nothing about specific move types (pan, zoom, orbit, static) or how they are directed, and it reads as re-angling an existing clip rather than directing motion at generation time. Motion Transfer and Pikaframes are adjacent features and are not credited. Missing for 10: documented camera move types (pan/zoom/orbit/static), controls for directing motion during generation, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
